package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"
)

func TestStudentReadinessStackValuesJSONPreservesAnsweredEmptyArray(t *testing.T) {
	input := StudentReadinessStackValues{State: StudentReadinessArrayAnswered, Values: []string{}, ValuesPresent: true}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if string(raw) != `{"state":"answered","values":[]}` {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected answered JSON: %s", raw)
	}
	var decoded StudentReadinessStackValues
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &decoded); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if decoded.State != StudentReadinessArrayAnswered || !decoded.ValuesPresent || decoded.Values == nil || len(decoded.Values) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("answered empty array was not preserved: %#v", decoded)
	}
}

func TestStudentReadinessStackValuesJSONPreservesUnansweredAbsenceAndRejectsDrift(t *testing.T) {
	input := StudentReadinessStackValues{State: StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if string(raw) != `{"state":"unanswered"}` {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected unanswered JSON: %s", raw)
	}
	var decoded StudentReadinessStackValues
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &decoded); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if decoded.State != StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered || decoded.ValuesPresent || decoded.Values != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unanswered absence was not preserved: %#v", decoded)
	}
	for _, malformed := range []string{
		`{"state":"answered"}`,
		`{"state":"answered","values":null}`,
		`{"state":"unanswered","values":[]}`,
		`{"state":"answered","values":[],"unknown":true}`,
		`{"state":"answered","values":[]} {}`,
	} {
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(malformed), &decoded); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("accepted malformed stack state: %s", malformed)
		}
	}
}
